answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A saffron of per-task receipts records who did what, and the thread of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the pigment is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
